issues.title: UAT Defect: Exam Assignment — No UI path to manage assignments for active exams
issues.root_cause_summary: ISS-034 side effect: isReadOnly=true for active exams disables the Step 1 Next button, blocking wizard navigation to Step 3 (Assignments). No alternative 'Assign' entry point exists on ExamsListPage for active exams. Backend assignment APIs are fully functional.

notes.s1_step8_format_mismatch: S1 Step 8 regex /2\s*(attempt|tries)/i did not match actual UI text 'Attempt 0 of 2'. This is a scenario description mismatch, not a functional defect — the information is present. The scenario script should be updated to reflect the actual format after ISS-035 is resolved.
notes.backend_status: All assignment APIs verified functional: POST /api/v1/exams/:id/assign (201), GET /api/v1/exams/:id/assignments (200), DELETE /api/v1/exams/:id/assign/:id (204).

next_action: Delegate ISS-035 to Issue Resolution. After fix, re-run UAT with same scenario script (docs/uat-scenarios/exam-assignment-20260609.md). Retry iteration: 1 of 3.
